name: Birthday reminders
pitch: Set up automated reminders for close contacts' birthdays and work anniversaries.
instructions: Start by asking the person who counts as a close contact, and whether they want reminders for birthdays only, work anniversaries only, or both. Use mail_list to see their recent messages and identify contacts who have sent birthday wishes or work anniversary notes. For each contact found, note their name and the next date that matters. Create a calendar event for each date using calendar_create, set to repeat yearly, and set a reminder for one day before. If a contact has not been seen in mail, ask the person whether to look them up elsewhere or skip them. When all contacts have been processed, show the person a summary of the reminders created and ask if they want to add any more. If the person types a new contact name, add that name to the list and create a calendar event for their next birthday or work anniversary, using the date they provide. When nothing is found in mail for a contact, say so and ask whether to skip or look up manually. Never invent dates or birth years. Tell the person plainly what could not be checked.

examples.ask: set up reminders for birthdays and work anniversaries
examples.does: ask who counts as close contact, then check mail for dates and create yearly calendar events with one-day-before reminders

skills.name: find-contacts-in-mail
skills.description: Look through recent mail to identify people who have sent birthday or work anniversary wishes.
skills.body: 1. Use mail_list to show the most recent 50 messages. 2. Scan each message for names and phrases like 'happy birthday' or 'work anniversary'. 3. When a name is found, note it down and note the date mentioned in the message. 4. If a message has both birthday and work anniversary, note both dates. 5. When the list is done, tell the person how many contacts were found and ask if they want to keep all of them.

skills.name: create-yearly-reminders
skills.description: Make calendar events that repeat every year with a one-day-before reminder.
skills.body: 1. For each contact, use calendar_create to make an event on the noted date. 2. Set the event title to the contact's name and the reason (birthday or work anniversary). 3. Set a reminder alarm for one day before the date. 4. Set the event to repeat yearly so it comes back next year automatically. 5. If the date has already passed this year, set the first occurrence for next year. 6. After creating the event, tell the person the name and date that was added.

rules.name: ask before adding calendar events
rules.description: ask the person before each calendar event is created so they can confirm or change the date

rules.name: ask before remembering facts about the person
rules.description: ask the person before any fact is remembered about them

readme:
# Birthday reminders
Automated reminders for close contacts' birthdays and work anniversaries.

What it does: checks recent mail for birthday and work anniversary messages, then creates yearly calendar events with one-day-before reminders.
What it needs: access to mail and calendar.
What it will not do: invent birth years or dates it cannot find. It will ask the person before adding any calendar event.
